title: Project Manager I
jobDescription: IT Project Manager – Strong Business Analysis Background (SDLC + AI-Driven Development) Overview We are seeking an experienced IT Project Manager to lead software development initiatives with a strong emphasis on Business Analysis . This role is responsible for driving successful project delivery through effective SDLC governance while enabling teams to leverage AI-powered tools to improve productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency. The ideal candidate will possess strong project management expertise, excellent business analysis skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of software development projects, ensuring timely, cost-effective, and high-quality outcomes. Define, manage, and control project scope, objectives, timelines, and deliverables in collaboration with key stakeholders. Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business requirements using industry-standard business analysis techniques. Develop and maintain project documentation, including: Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs) User Stories Use Cases Process Flows Data Models Ensure complete traceability between business requirements and technical deliverables. Manage cross-functional teams comprising software developers, QA engineers, AI tooling specialists, data engineers, and operations teams. Ensure adherence to Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes across requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.  Drive adoption of AI-enabled development practices to enhance engineering productivity and software quality.  Act as a Scrum Master or Agile Project Lead, facilitating sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and removing delivery impediments.  Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks while proactively managing scope changes through established governance processes.  Maintain strong stakeholder engagement by providing regular updates on project progress, milestones, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.  Collaborate with QA teams to define testing strategies, acceptance criteria, automation approaches, and successful project sign-offs.   Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. Proven experience as an IT Project Manager delivering software development projects. Strong Business Analysis experience with expertise in requirements gathering, documentation, process modeling, and stakeholder management. Deep understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies. Experience managing AI-enabled software development initiatives (AI/ML technical expertise is not mandatory). Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies, Scrum framework, and project delivery best practices. Proficiency in project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, and Microsoft Project. Excellent leadership, communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to translate business requirements into clear technical specifications. Preferred Qualifications CBAP, CCBA, PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, or equivalent certifications. Experience leading cross-functional teams in fast-paced Agile environments. Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Familiarity with AI services and developer productivity tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or Azure OpenAI. Experience working in enterprise-scale digital transformation or software modernization programs.

title: Lead II - Software Engineering
jobDescription: The Java Tech Lead is responsible for leading the design, development, and delivery of scalable, high-performance backend systems. This role plays a critical part in driving technical architecture, ensuring engineering excellence, and mentoring development teams. The ideal candidate demonstrates deep expertise in Java,Spring technologies, strong leadership skills, and the ability to understand business requirements and balance hands-on development with technical oversight in a fast-paced agile environment. Primary Responsibilities - Lead the design and development of scalable, secure, and high-performing Java applications and microservices. - Adhere to design principals , understand architectural patterns and define engineering best practices. - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to development teams. - Review code, enforce coding standards, and ensure high-quality deliverables. - Collaborate with product, QA teams to deliver end-to-end solutions. - Own and drive technical decision-making for projects and platforms. - Ensure system reliability, security , scalability, and performance optimization. - Include automation and performance (where applicable) as part of design and development. Secondary / Shared Responsibilities - Drive adoption of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices. - Participate in capacity planning, performance tuning, and system optimization. - Contribute to roadmap planning and technical strategy. - Lead sprint planning, backlog grooming, and technical estimations. - Ensure proper documentation of architecture, design, and processes. - Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and continuous improvement initiatives. Key Skills & Competencies - Expert-level proficiency in Java (Java 17 or higher). - Strong experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Hibernate. - Deep understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems. - Experience with REST APIs, API gateways, and service orchestration. - Strong knowledge of databases (SQL/NoSQL – MySQL, MongoDB, etc.). - Experience with messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ). - Familiarity with cloud platforms ( Azure, or GCP). - Strong understanding of CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.). - Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. - Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Qualifications - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent. - 12+ years of experience in Java development. - 2–4 years of experience in a technical leadership role. - Experience in enterprise-scale, distributed systems is required. - Exposure to retail / supply chain / high-volume transactional systems is a plus. Performance Metrics - System design quality and scalability - Code quality and adherence to standards - Team productivity and delivery timelines - Production stability and incident reduction - SLA adherence for critical issues - Technical debt reduction and optimization initiatives - Stakeholder satisfaction and delivery predictability Work Environment - Agile, fast-paced engineering environment. - Requires leading cross-functional and distributed teams. - Hands-on leadership role with both coding and design responsibilities. - May involve production support oversight and escalation handling.

title: Developer II - Software Engineering

Performance Metrics - Code quality (defect density, code review feedback) - Sprint velocity and story completion rate - Production defect rate - System performance and uptime - SLA adherence for bug fixes and enhancements - Turnaround time for feature delivery Work Environment - Agile, fast-paced engineering environment. - Requires collaboration across distributed teams. - May involve handling production support and on-call rotations. - Focus on delivering scalable and high-performance systems.

title: Lead I - Software Testing
jobDescription: Job Description – Senior ServiceNow QA Analyst Focus: CMDB, CSDM, ITOM and Enterprise Service Management Testing Role Summary The candidate should have a strong background in ServiceNow Quality Assurance and test engineering, with extensive experience in validating ServiceNow platform implementations across key modules and a demonstrated ability to design, execute, and govern testing for Configuration Management Database (CMDB) and Common Service Data Model (CSDM) capabilities. The role requires deep knowledge of testing methodologies applied to ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, SecOps, SPM, Discovery, Service Mapping, integrations, and data governance. The Senior ServiceNow QA Analyst will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and data integrity of platform solutions that improve service visibility, configuration data quality, operational efficiency, and business-service alignment. Key Responsibilities Lead the design, development, and execution of ServiceNow test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scripts covering functional, integration, regression, UAT, and end-to-end testing. Collaborate with business, infrastructure, security, and application stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into comprehensive test coverage and acceptance criteria. Perform testing across ServiceNow modules including ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, SecOps, SPM, Discovery, and Service Mapping. Own end-to-end validation of the CMDB implementation, including CI class design, identification and reconciliation rules, data sources, relationships, lifecycle states, normalization, and data certification outcomes. Validate CSDM adoption and data model integrity across foundation data, design, manage technical services, sell/consume, and service portfolio domains, in line with the organization's maturity and roadmap. Test and verify application services, business applications, technical services, service offerings, dynamic CI groups, and their relationships against CSDM guidance. Execute CMDB Health validation including completeness, correctness, compliance, duplicate management, orphan CI remediation, stale CI controls, and data-quality reporting. Validate CMDB data ingestion from ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, cloud platforms, endpoint tools, asset systems, monitoring solutions, and third-party data sources. Design and execute test coverage for business rules, Script Includes, client scripts, UI policies, data policies, Flow Designer flows, IntegrationHub spokes, and other configuration elements. Validate Service Catalog items, workflows, approvals, notifications, and request-fulfilment processes. Test integrations built using REST, SOAP, MID Server, IntegrationHub, import sets, transform maps, and scripted APIs. Validate security controls, including ACLs, roles, data segregation, and secure integration practices through negative and role-based testing. Design and implement Automated Test Framework (ATF) suites for regression testing, upgrade readiness, and continuous validation. Monitor and report defects, root-cause analyses, quality metrics, and coverage dashboards; drive defect triage and closure with development teams. Provide QA leadership, test-case reviews, quality assurance for design deliverables, troubleshooting support, and mentorship to junior testers. Partner with process owners and platform governance teams to define CMDB/CSDM data-quality standards, ownership, stewardship, and continuous-improvement plans. Support release management activities including UAT coordination, upgrade testing, and post-deployment validation. Stay current with ServiceNow product releases, CMDB/CSDM guidance, testing best practices, and emerging capabilities. Required Skills and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 5+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow testing and quality assurance, including experience validating enterprise-scale implementations. Strong hands-on experience testing ServiceNow CMDB, including CI class modeling, relationships, Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE), reconciliation rules, data sources, transform maps, and CMDB Health validation. Practical experience validating CSDM implementations, including business applications, application services, technical services, service offerings, and supporting foundation data. Experience testing ServiceNow Discovery and/or Service Mapping outputs, including MID Server validation, credentials, patterns, discovery pattern debugging, and reconciliation of discovered data. In-depth understanding of CMDB governance, data ownership, lifecycle management, certification, normalization, duplicate remediation, and data-quality controls from a testing perspective. Strong proficiency in ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF), test-case design, defect management, and QA best practices. Working knowledge of JavaScript, Glide APIs, HTML, CSS, XML, and ServiceNow scripting sufficient to read, debug, and validate platform code. Extensive testing experience across at least three ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, GRC/IRM, SecOps, and SPM. Proven experience testing scoped or custom applications on the ServiceNow platform. Experience validating ServiceNow integrations using REST, SOAP, IntegrationHub, MID Server, and other APIs (API testing tools such as Postman, SoapUI). Solid understanding of ITIL practices, service management processes, asset management, infrastructure domains, and application-service dependencies. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex platform, integration, Discovery, and CMDB data issues. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA), or equivalent demonstrable platform expertise. Preferred Skills ServiceNow CIS – Discovery, CIS – Service Mapping, CIS – ITSM, CIS – CSM, or other relevant implementation certifications. ISTQB (Foundation / Advanced) or equivalent QA certification. Hands-on experience with CSDM adoption assessments, maturity roadmaps, data-model remediation, and migration validation from legacy or custom service models. Experience validating Service Graph Connectors, Multisource CMDB, CMDB Data Manager, Data Certification, and IntegrationHub ETL. Knowledge of cloud and infrastructure platforms such as AWS, Azure, VMware, Kubernetes, network devices, databases, and enterprise applications for infrastructure test validation. Experience with test automation tools (Selenium, Cypress, Tosca) integrated with ServiceNow ATF. Experience with Agile / Scrum delivery methodologies, DevOps practices, CI/CD test integration, source control, and ServiceNow application deployment testing. Familiarity with defect-tracking and test-management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, HP ALM, qTest, or Zephyr. Understanding of ITIL 4, service portfolio management, enterprise architecture, and application portfolio management concepts. Experience validating ServiceNow low-code/no-code capabilities, including Flow Designer, App Engine Studio, UI Builder, and Workspace configuration. Ability to facilitate technical workshops, walkthroughs, and defect triage sessions with architects, process owners, operations teams, and senior stakeholders.
